Note that this will be invoked only if beforeHandle successfully completed and returned a Message, i.e. it did not return null.
items.translation: 注意，仅当 `beforeHandle` 成功完成并返回一个 `Message`（即未返回 `null`）时才会调用此方法。

items.source: An extension of ChannelInterceptor with callbacks to intercept the asynchronous sending of a Message to a specific subscriber through an Executor. Supported on MessageChannel implementations that can be configured with an Executor.
items.translation: `ChannelInterceptor` 接口的扩展，提供回调以拦截通过 `Executor` 异步发送 `Message` 到特定订阅者的操作。支持可配置为使用 `Executor` 的 `MessageChannel` 实现。

items.source: Invoked inside the Runnable submitted to the Executor just before calling the target MessageHandler to handle the message. Allows for modification of the Message if necessary or when null is returned the MessageHandler is not invoked.
items.translation: 在调用目标 MessageHandler 处理消息之前，提交给 Executor 的Runnable内部被调用。允许在必要时修改 Message，或者当返回null时不调用 MessageHandler。
